$comment: Cross-language conformance fixture for how a query row is written into a URL (issue #1771). Read by BOTH the engine gtest suite (engine/tests/query_encoding_test.cpp, via VAYU_ENGINE_SOURCE_DIR) and the app's vitest suite (app/src/modules/request-builder/utils/query-encoding.conformance.test.ts). The rule is Postman's own, checked against postman-url-encoder 3.0.8 `toNodeUrl` (index.js:204-215) over postman-collection 5.3.1's `Url`: the query string is `QueryParam.unparse` (query-param.js:268-287), whose `normalizeParam` (:57-96) encodes `&` and `#` in a value and `&`, `#` and `=` in a key, skipping every whole `{{...}}` token (/{{[^{}]*}}/); then `encodeQueryParam` (encoder/index.js:203-210) applies QUERY_ENCODE_SET (encoder/encode-set.js:30, 111-115, 183-191): the C0 controls, DEL, every byte above `~` (each UTF-8 byte, `%XX` uppercase), space, `"`, `#`, `'`, `<`, `>`. Nothing else is encoded: `%` passes as written, so an escape is never encoded twice, and `+`, `|`, `/`, `?`, `[`, `]`, `{`, `}` and the rest go out as typed. `components`: `text` encoded as a key (`key`) and as a value (`value`). `queries`: a request's query rows (`rows`), joined into `https://x/` with the rule above, or as typed when `encode` is false (Postman's `disableUrlEncoding`); `query` is what follows the `?`, empty meaning no `?` at all. Two Vayu rules differ from Postman on purpose and are pinned here: an empty value writes a bare `key` (Postman writes `key=` for an empty string; Vayu's rows cannot tell an empty string from null), and a row whose key is empty or whitespace is skipped (Postman writes `=value`).

components.name: unreserved characters pass
a pipe passes (the issue's case)
a space is %20
double quote, single quote and angle brackets are encoded
a hash is %23
an ampersand is %26 in both parts
an equals sign is %3D in a key and passes in a value
a plus passes as a literal plus
the rest of the reserved and sub-delimiter set passes
a valid escape passes
an invalid escape passes
a lone trailing percent passes
an escaped percent is not encoded again
a two-byte UTF-8 character is encoded per byte
three-byte UTF-8 characters are encoded per byte
a four-byte UTF-8 character is encoded per byte
C0 controls and DEL are encoded
a whole token passes
a token is never encoded inside
text after a token is still encoded
text around a token is encoded and the token is not
an equals sign inside a token passes even in a key
unclosed braces are not a token
a brace inside the braces means no token
the empty string stays empty

queries.name: the issue's case: a pipe passes and a space is %20
only disabled rows give no query and no question mark
an empty value writes a bare key (a known difference from Postman's key=)
an empty or whitespace-only key is skipped
an equals sign is encoded in a key and passes in a value
an ampersand is encoded in both parts
a pre-encoded value is not encoded twice
a value's text after a token is still encoded
encode false writes the rows as typed
encode false leaves an ampersand in a value as typed
